range_scope.S2009-FOY-A: 20–40 and 0–20 cm are sediment-drive coordinates on different scales. Contacts bound a potentially concentrated ash package.
range_scope.B2020-068: Hurricane Creek combines 12.5 cm wet bog, 25 cm corrected and 40 cm upland-equivalent thickness. The original equivalent requires an unverified capture and density transfer. The compiled ± term does not bound one field measurement.
